lane: new local and bounded-product exact uses

ranking.meaning: Conditional preference for next information, not a verified financial-asset rank or authorization.
ranking.assumptions_for_comparison: Equal all-in cost/time, obtainable evidence, adequate starting article and reusable outputs or economic rights are hypothetical, not offered terms.
ranking.new_vs_incumbent_judgment: Erlotinib can outrank APR/RM/BLU qualification-only substitutes for a bounded information commitment under those assumptions because of existing blinded human pain evidence. Superiority to the incumbents' original useful-function opportunities is not established.
ranking.cash_comparison: No priced obtainable commitment is established superior to cash or waiting. Unknown terms do not by themselves prove negative EV.

records.name: Topical erlotinib plus keratolytic for KRT16 p.Arg127Cys hereditary palmoplantar keratoderma

exact_use.article: 1% topical erlotinib ointment with keratolytic co-treatment as reported; extemporaneously compounded presentation, not a qualified current lot or interchangeable SGT-210 product.
exact_use.genotype_scope: KRT16 c.379C>T, p.Arg127Cys in one pedigree
exact_use.intended_claim: Useful ongoing reduction in painful fissuring and improved walking/mobility
not_established: Efficacy across all KRT16 variants or all pachyonychia congenita

unresolved: Other uninspected historical work or unrecognized aliases
novelty.note: Prior erlotinib uses are different disease/route/product contexts; SGT-210 is relevant external program context, not inherited evidence for this exact presentation.

evidence.design: Blinded randomized comparisons between feet, followed by uncontrolled extensions
evidence.comparator: Vehicle plus keratolytic in the later informative phase
positive: Mother's treated-foot pain fell from 8–10 to 0–3 in the informative comparison.
Later bilateral uncontrolled extension accompanied by pain freedom and improved walking/swimming.
Son had modest improvement in the blinded phase and subsequent uncontrolled improvement.
limitations: Initial lower-strength comparison gave little benefit.
Formulation and co-treatment cannot be removed from the efficacy claim.
Feet, repeated phases and extension visits are not new patients.
No measured systemic exposure or uncommon-risk inference.

evidence.contrary: Topical use was inconclusive in one patient and without significant improvement in the other.
evidence.scope: Oral EGFR-inhibitor responses are not topical-product efficacy; differing article/genotype prevents treating this as a definitive failure of the exact Arg127Cys combination.

lineage.not_pooled: Two separate reports differ in genotype, formulation and route sequences; no four-person responder estimate.

rights_and_capture.established: Sol-Gel's 2026-08-20 release says it continues SGT-210 topical EGFR development.
unresolved: Adequacy/transfer of the intended compounded article
A meaningful product or clinical-evidence contribution beyond generic off-label care
Current exact-use claims, title and obtainable commercial terms
rights_and_capture.not_inferred: Active external program is not an available license, and generic active ingredient is not a complete development package.

records.next_information_question: Can an adequate article, feasible clinically useful comparison, exposure interpretation and retained contribution define an obtainable controlled proof for the exact phenotype?
minimum_deliverable: Clinical pain/mobility and comparator scope appropriate to existing human evidence
Separate terms for qualification, clinical proof and usable output rights

conditional_comparison.judgment: Plausibly prefer this package to equally priced APR/RM/BLU qualification-only scopes if it yields a more actionable clinical decision with comparable rights; not shown superior to their original function-oriented tranches.
conditional_comparison.reversal: Preference reverses if only an unowned repeat of off-label guidance is feasible, or article/safety/clinical access costs grow beyond the informative scope.

branches.advance: Compare an actual bounded clinical-development proposal if an adequate article, useful outcome, feasible comparator and retained contribution are established.
branches.hold_or_rescope: Uninterpretable article/exposure, burden offsetting benefit, or no economically usable contribution.
branches.stop_source_work: Reopen only for new exact-use controlled evidence, consequential article/exposure data or concrete rights/access information.

access_limits: Publisher page was access-gated, but complete two-page PC Project PDF was read.
No independent patient-level dataset or full commercial rights audit.

records.name: Ophthalmic dornase alfa for severe tear-deficient dry eye

exact_use.article: 0.1% recombinant DNase I/dornase alfa ophthalmic use of an existing starting product in the published pilot; not interchangeable with proprietary L304.
exact_use.population_scope: Mixed Sjögren, non-Sjögren and ocular graft-versus-host disease pilot; no validated subgroup efficacy.
exact_use.intended_claim: Clinically useful improvement in ocular-surface disease and symptoms with acceptable treatment burden

unresolved: Other uninspected historical work or unrecognized aliases
novelty.note: Prior systemic/local non-ocular DNase discussions do not establish this exact ocular-use coverage. External dry-eye screening concerned TOP1630.

records.disposition: Conditional clinical/product reserve with license and symptom gates

negative_or_limiting: A significant within-arm symptom change does not establish between-arm symptom efficacy.
No general Schirmer tear-production benefit established.
Six dropouts and completer outcome summaries; corneal-staining sensitivity analysis does not settle every outcome.
Two eyes and repeated measurements are clustered within people.
No rare/long-term safety inference from this small eight-week pilot.

registry.stated_reason: Sponsor ceased sponsorship and terminated the research citing slow accrual.

rights_and_capture.established: Neutrolis announced an exclusive UIC license for topical ocular DNase use on 2024-12-23 and a proprietary L304 program.
rights_and_capture.evidence_type: Issuer release, not underlying license agreement
rights_and_capture.plausible_route: Partnership/data-use or a differentiated product with an independently justified contribution; not assumed freely owned replication of the pilot drops.

records.next_information_question: Does usable controlled symptom/phenotype evidence plus an attainable contribution under the announced license support a defined clinical/product proof?
minimum_deliverable: Reconciled controlled symptom/sign and phenotype scope
Scoped partnership or differentiated-contribution terms separate from later clinical costs

conditional_comparison.judgment: Randomized sign evidence is more developed than a target hypothesis, but the inconclusive registered symptom outcome and explicit license context place this behind erlotinib's bounded new-use information question in this lane.
conditional_comparison.cash: Waiting dominates an undefined proprietary investment; that is not a conclusion that clinical research lacks value.

branches.advance: A feasible obtainable partnership, usable data package or meaningful product contribution plus an interpretable clinical claim.
branches.hold_or_rescope: Only the old sign result is available, meaningful symptoms remain unsupported, or no attainable contribution exists.
branches.stop_source_work: No broad repeat search without a primary clinical update, access/rights change or actual offered package.

access_limits: Full primary paper and filtered official registry status/outcome data read.
License announcement read; underlying agreement and later L304 efficacy not audited.

records.name: Amlexanox for selected COL7A1 nonsense RDEB

exact_use.article: Amlexanox as a read-through candidate; a qualified topical skin product is not established.
exact_use.genotype_scope: Selected COL7A1 premature-termination variants; response depends on allele and cellular context.
exact_use.route: Intended local skin product; the verified evidence is cell/organotypic, not human topical exposure.
exact_use.intended_claim: Useful reduction in skin fragility/wounds from functionally adequate collagen VII
not_established: Qualified local formulation or clinical exposure window

unresolved: Other uninspected historical work or unrecognized aliases
novelty.external_scout_uncertainty: Screen L contains a single root-scout amlexanox alias without use detail. This does not prove prior RDEB overlap, but prevents claiming the molecule was untouched.

records.disposition: Genotype-specific preclinical reserve; unresolved clinical-program information first

evidence.biological_units: Patient material, allele backgrounds and culture/organotypic observations; not 14 treated patients.
positive: Full-length collagen VII expression and secretion
Dermal–epidermal junction localization in organotypic skin
negative_or_limiting: Four mutation contexts were not responsive.
Primary, immortalized and carcinoma-derived backgrounds are not interchangeable replications.
Protein expression/localization does not establish useful mechanical skin function.
Higher-concentration cell-growth effects leave exposure-window interpretation unresolved.

registry_gap.conflicting_secondary_signal: EB Research Network search-index snippet suggested closed/terminated; retrieved page did not expose the row.

unresolved: Current clinical program and usable outcomes
Genotype selection and clinically meaningful function
Meaningful retained contribution and current rights
rights_and_capture.not_inferred: Historical oral-ulcer use and absent identified license do not establish qualified topical skin use or FTO.

records.next_information_question: Can the actual clinical-program status/results resolve whether a new genotype-specific functional proof is warranted?
minimum_deliverable: Primary clinical-program status and usable results, if publicly obtainable
A claim-specific functional decision distinct from collagen localization
Separate actual terms for information, functional qualification and later clinical work

branches.advance: Verified useful functional or clinical evidence in an appropriate allele context, with an adequate article and a feasible retained contribution.
branches.hold_or_rescope: Only molecular localization is available or trial status/results remain unresolved.
branches.stop: A qualified informative result fails the intended useful function at a relevant exposure; no universal target rejection from a nonresponsive allele alone.
branches.stop_source_work: No repeated broad search without a named primary trial/results artifact or consequential product fact.

access_limits: CTRI primary body and human results not recovered.
Secondary status labels conflict; no enrollment or result inferred.

records.name: Topical timolol for chronic diabetic foot ulcers and healed epithelial integrity

exact_use.article: Topical timolol gel added to standard diabetic-foot-ulcer care in the BAART-DFU program.
exact_use.intended_claim: Useful complete healing and durable healed-site integrity with acceptable total burden
not_established: Convincing superiority on the reported controlled primary closure outcome
A standalone treatment effect apart from standard care
A qualified commercial wound product or exclusive opportunity

unresolved: Other uninspected historical work or unrecognized aliases
novelty.note: No timolol/Timoptic/BAART match in the inspected baseline or thirteen external reports; uninspected scopes remain open.

records.disposition: Hold paid promotion; reconcile controlled clinical outcomes

evidence.design: Randomized placebo-controlled trial with standard care
limitations: Primary efficacy is not clearly established by these counts.
Later time-to-event interpretation requires its analysis population and censoring.
Registry phase/masking descriptions differ from paper labels; no misconduct inference.

evidence.design: Conference report of the same trial program
evidence.internal_count_percent_conflict: 7/27 is printed as 33%; do not silently substitute the percentage for the count.
evidence.lineage_limit: 108 initially enrolled/screened is not the randomized or treated denominator.

evidence.design: Post-hoc selected healed-participant barrier analysis from the same trial
evidence.positive: Lower TEWL supports a healed-barrier measurement signal.
evidence.negative: No significant re-ulceration difference over one year.
limitations: Conditioning on healing and selecting participants can bias causal interpretation.
Repeated readings, visits and measurement observations are not extra people.

lineage.repository_cover_conflict: Repository wrapper describes a 2024 conference item; the embedded body is the 2025 full article with DOI10.1159/000545357.
timepoint_conflicts: Registry primary12 weeks vs conference primary14/results15

rights_and_capture.not_inferred: Existing generic ophthalmic product and clinical signal do not establish commercial wound-product rights, current supply or advantageous total care costs.

records.next_information_question: Can the prespecified primary endpoint/timepoint, population, missingness and adjusted/unadjusted analyses be reconciled into a credible useful healing or recurrence claim?
minimum_deliverable: Trial-to-post-hoc participant lineage and missingness account
Explicit intended healing versus barrier/recurrence claim
A differentiated contribution and actual scope if clinical evidence becomes sufficient

branches.advance: Only after primary clinical reconciliation supports a useful claim and a distinct obtainable contribution.
branches.hold: Current controlled primary and recurrence evidence do not justify paid promotion.
branches.stop_source_work: A further mechanistic or barrier-only source does not resolve the central controlled-clinical uncertainty; reopen for a consequential primary correction or independent clinical result.

access_limits: Full institutional article body read despite a mismatched repository cover.
Official registry API results and conference report read; no raw participant-level data obtained.

rejectionlog.name: Glafenine / SLC4A11 folding correction for corneal endothelial disease
rejectionlog.reason: Transfected-cell trafficking/water-flux rescue does not establish patient corneal pump function or vision; historical systemic safety liabilities and an unqualified ocular article make this a product-development project.
rejectionlog.biological_units: Three to five independent cell experiments in portions of the paper; many measured cells are not patient donors.
rejectionlog.disposition: Not retained as ready bounded-product lead

rejectionlog.name: Pirfenidone gel / pediatric burn hypertrophic scars
rejectionlog.known_compound_other_use: Urethral stricture in external Screens B/E
rejectionlog.reason: Abstract-level 33 versus30 pediatric comparison and scar-score benefit; full allocation/blinding methods and useful functional benefit not verified. Unreliable current brand page cannot establish availability.
rejectionlog.disposition: Not retained ahead of the four local records

rejectionlog.name: Tideglusib / pulp capping
rejectionlog.reason: Full2025 comparator study has56teeth in only2dogs, no significant hard-tissue advantage overMTA and unfavorable inflammatory/structural findings. No ready superiority thesis; limited study is not universal target failure.
